verdict.rationale: TeamViewer is a remote-access product, so viewing a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers monitor selection, window or app sharing, or switching displays mid-session. The pack only addresses pricing tiers, AI features, device management, and community complaints unrelated to display handling.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session
